authorization_semantics: When TinySnow reaches a new paid image-generation/edit gate that otherwise satisfies all zero-paid preflight and source-preservation safety requirements, this authorization may be consumed once without asking the Owner again. It permits at most one image and one paid request, total cost must not exceed NT$50. After the first paid request is sent, this authorization is consumed regardless of success/failure and cannot be reused automatically.
preconditions: Exact Source Truth product/variant identity is known
Provider request can be bounded to one request and one output image
Expected/known cost does not exceed NT$50
must_stop_and_ask_owner_if: More than one image is required
More than one paid request is required
Source Truth or preservation guard is not PASS
A previous request under this authorization has already been sent
owner_instruction: Do not ask again for this one-image paid generation permission unless the scope would exceed the limits above.
